import re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu, gaussian_kde

SEQ = {"AIG1":"MALVPCQVLRMAILLSYCSILCNYKAIEMPSHQTYGGSWKFLTFIDLVIQAVFFGICVLTDLSSLLTRGSGNQEQERQLKKLISLRDWMLAVLAFPVGVFVVAVFWIIYAYDREMIYPKLLDNFIPGWLNHGMHTTVLPFILIEMRTSHHQYPSRSSGLTAICTFSVGYILWVCWVHHVTGMWVYPFLEHIGPGARIIFFGSTTILMNFLYLLGEVLNNYIWDTQKSMEEEKEKPKLE",
       "ADTRP":"MTKTSTCIYHFLVLSWYTFLNYYISQEGKDEVKPKILANGARWKYMTLLNLLLQTIFYGVTCLDDVLKRTKGGKDIKFLTAFRDLLFTTLAFPVSTFVFLAFWILFLYNRDLIYPKVLDTVIPVWLNHAMHTFIFPITLAEVVLRPHSYPSKKTGLTLLAAASIAYISRILWLYFETGTWVYPVFAKLSLLGLAAFFSLSYVFIASIYLLGEKLNHWKWGDMRQPRKKRK"}
TM  = {"AIG1":[(13,30),(45,67),(88,110),(125,144),(157,179),(194,216)],
       "ADTRP":[(4,24),(47,67),(86,106),(120,140),(155,175),(190,210)]}
KD = dict(zip("AVLIPFMWGSTCYNQDEKRH",[1.8,4.2,3.8,4.5,-1.6,2.8,1.9,-.9,-.4,-.8,-.7,2.5,-1.3,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.9,-4.5,-3.2]))
EI = dict(zip("AVLIPFMWGSTCYNQDEKRH",[.62,1.08,1.06,1.38,.12,1.19,.64,.81,.48,-.18,-.05,.29,.26,-.78,-.85,-.9,-.74,-1.5,-2.53,-.4]))
WW = dict(zip("AVLIPFMWGSTCYNQDEKRH",[-.5,-.46,-1.25,-1.12,.14,-1.71,-.67,-2.09,1.15,.46,.25,-.02,-.71,.85,.77,3.64,3.63,2.8,1.81,.11]))
def hyd(seq, sc, w=19):
    v=[sc.get(c,0) for c in seq]; h=w//2
    return np.array([np.mean(v[max(0,i-h):i+h+1]) for i in range(len(v))])
def consensus(seq):
    z=[]
    for sc,flip in [(KD,1),(EI,1),(WW,-1)]:
        x=flip*hyd(seq,sc); z.append((x-x.mean())/x.std())
    return np.mean(z,0)
def segs(c, thr, minlen=12):
    out=[]; i=0
    while i<len(c):
        if c[i]>thr:
            j=i
            while j<len(c) and c[j]>thr: j+=1
            if j-i>=minlen: out.append((i+1,j))
            i=j
        else: i+=1
    return out
THRS=[0.90,0.70,0.55,0.40,0.25,0.10,0.00,-0.10,-0.20]
cons={g:consensus(SEQ[g]) for g in SEQ}
sweep={g:[len(segs(cons[g],t)) for t in THRS] for g in SEQ}
for g in SEQ: print(g,"segments vs threshold:",dict(zip(THRS,sweep[g])),"| truth = 6")

POLAR=set("STCNQYWHDEKRP")
pol={g:[(s,e,100*sum(ch in POLAR for ch in SEQ[g][s-1:e])/(e-s+1)) for s,e in TM[g]] for g in SEQ}
print("AIG1 per-helix polar/aromatic %:", [(f"TM{i+1}",round(v,1)) for i,(_,_,v) in enumerate(pol["AIG1"])])

hp=pd.read_csv("out/human_reviewed.tsv",sep="\t").dropna(subset=["Sequence","Transmembrane"])
rng=re.compile(r"TRANSMEM (\d+)\.\.(\d+)")
hp["nTM"]=hp.Transmembrane.astype(str).str.count("TRANSMEM")
sub=hp[hp.nTM>=6].copy()
def mkd_row(row):
    rs=rng.findall(str(row.Transmembrane)); s=str(row.Sequence)
    return np.mean([np.mean([KD.get(ch,0) for ch in s[int(a)-1:int(b)]]) for a,b in rs]) if rs else np.nan
sub["mKD"]=sub.apply(mkd_row,axis=1); sub=sub.dropna(subset=["mKD"])
go=sub["Gene Ontology (cellular component)"].fillna("")
ER=sub[go.str.contains("GO:0005789") & ~go.str.contains("GO:0005886")]
PM=sub[go.str.contains("GO:0005886") & ~go.str.contains("GO:0005789")]
u,p=mannwhitneyu(ER.mKD,PM.mKD); rb=2*u/(len(ER)*len(PM))-1
kER,kPM=gaussian_kde(ER.mKD),gaussian_kde(PM.mKD)
mkd={g:np.mean([np.mean([KD.get(ch,0) for ch in SEQ[g][s-1:e]]) for s,e in TM[g]]) for g in SEQ}
print(f"ER-only n={len(ER)} med {ER.mKD.median():.3f} | PM-only n={len(PM)} med {PM.mKD.median():.3f} | p={p:.3g} r={rb:+.3f}")
for g in SEQ:
    print(f"  {g} KD={mkd[g]:+.3f} LR(ER:PM)={float(kER(mkd[g])/kPM(mkd[g])):.2f} "
          f"pctER={100*(ER.mKD<mkd[g]).mean():.0f} pctPM={100*(PM.mKD<mkd[g]).mean():.0f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,8.5))
a=ax[0,0]
for g,c in [("AIG1","#c0392b"),("ADTRP","#2c6fbb")]: a.plot(THRS,sweep[g],"o-",color=c,label=g)
a.axhline(6,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); a.text(0.88,6.15,"6 helices (UniProt, AlphaFold)",fontsize=8)
a.set_xlabel("consensus hydropathy z threshold"); a.set_ylabel("TM segments called")
a.set_title("Naive 3-scale hydropathy never recovers 6 helices",fontsize=10)
a.invert_xaxis(); a.legend(fontsize=8); a.set_ylim(0,7)

a=ax[0,1]
a.plot(np.arange(1,len(SEQ["AIG1"])+1),cons["AIG1"],color="#c0392b",lw=1)
for i,(s,e) in enumerate(TM["AIG1"]):
    a.axvspan(s,e,color="grey",alpha=.25); a.text((s+e)/2,2.25,f"TM{i+1}",ha="center",fontsize=7)
a.axhline(0.55,ls=":",c="k",lw=1); a.text(3,0.68,"z = 0.55 calling threshold",fontsize=7)
for lab,i in [("Thr43",43),("His134",134)]:
    a.plot(i,cons["AIG1"][i-1],"v",color="darkgreen",ms=7)
    a.text(i,cons["AIG1"][i-1]+.28,lab,fontsize=7,ha="center",color="darkgreen")
a.set_xlabel("AIG1 residue"); a.set_ylabel("consensus hydropathy z"); a.set_ylim(-2.6,2.7)
a.set_title("TM1, TM4 and TM6 sit below the calling threshold",fontsize=10)

a=ax[1,0]
vals=[v for _,_,v in pol["AIG1"]]
a.bar([f"TM{i+1}\n{s}-{e}" for i,(s,e,_) in enumerate(pol["AIG1"])],vals,
      color=["#c0392b" if v>=35 else "#999999" for v in vals])
a.axhline(np.mean(vals),ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
a.text(5.4,np.mean(vals)+1.2,f"mean {np.mean(vals):.1f}%",fontsize=8,ha="right")
a.set_ylabel("polar and aromatic residues (%)"); a.tick_params(labelsize=7)
a.set_title("AIG1 TM helices are unusually polar, which defeats hydropathy calling",fontsize=10)

a=ax[1,1]
gx=np.linspace(0.5,2.7,400)
a.fill_between(gx,kER(gx),color="#2c6fbb",alpha=.35,label=f"ER only, n={len(ER)}")
a.fill_between(gx,kPM(gx),color="#e08214",alpha=.35,label=f"PM only, n={len(PM)}")
for g,c in [("AIG1","#c0392b"),("ADTRP","#111111")]:
    a.axvline(mkd[g],color=c,lw=2)
    a.text(mkd[g]-0.035,1.05,g,rotation=90,fontsize=8,color=c,ha="right")
a.set_xlabel("mean TM Kyte-Doolittle hydrophobicity"); a.set_ylabel("density")
a.set_title(f"Hydrophobic matching barely separates ER from PM\np={p:.1e}, rank-biserial r={rb:+.2f}; ER:PM likelihood ratio 1.7 for AIG1, 1.2 for ADTRP",fontsize=9)
a.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
